versions.changelog:
Initial release introducing presigned URL and signature diagnosis for Alibaba Cloud OSS:

- Diagnose OSS presigned (signed/share) URL failures and guide V1-to-V4 signature migration using local parsing only—no network or cloud API calls.
- Handles common failure scenarios: expired links, signature/version mismatches, credential/expiry errors, SDK and proxy misconfigurations, and parameter tampering.
- Mandatory to use the embedded diagnosis script; no free-form or speculative diagnosis is allowed.
- Strictly bounded to presigned-URL/root-cause analysis only—no billing, DDoS, transfer, backup, or other OSS feature support.
- Accurately routes requests based on symptoms or keywords, including Chinese use cases, according to the documented trigger catalog.
